record_type_quote: The results showed that traditional college students were less likely to write another essay if they had previously evaluated exemplary essays relative to poorly-written essays, replicating the discouragement-by-exposure-to-peer-excellence effect.

targets.evidence_quote: The goal of the present study is to further explore the discouragement-by-peer-excellence effect reported in Rogers and Feller (2016) among college students.
targets.outcome_quote: The results of the present study replicated those reported by Rogers and Feller (2016): Peer excellence can discourage (rather than elevate) student motivation.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The overall replication verdict confirms the effect; the new population moderator is an extension.
